{{Quote|I am Master Tho'natu of the Jedi. We're here to help you.''"<br />"''No! You'll never get me! No! No! No!|Tho'natu and Darovit|<ref name="RoT" />}}
'''Tho'natu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the final years of the [[New Sith Wars]]. As a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], he fought in the [[Ruusan campaign]], and by [[990 BBY]] he had ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In that year, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] received a [[Message drone|message]] revealing that an injured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], and Tho'natu and a [[Ambria strike team|team]] of thirteen other Jedi were sent to arrest the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]. Upon their arrival, they were [[Confrontation on Ambria|attacked]] by the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darovit]], who Tho'natu and the others quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]], believing him to be the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]. Unbeknownst to the Jedi, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] had [[Force stealth|hidden]] herself and her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]&mdash;the Sith Lord to whom the message actually referred&mdash;and had [[Summon fear|driven]] Darovit insane. Erroneously believing the Sith to be eliminated, Tho'natu and the team of Jedi left, resulting in the survival of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|A Sith Lord still lives. He killed five Jedi on Tython. He is now on Ambria, under the care of a healer named Caleb. He is badly injured and helpless.|Zannah's message to the Jedi|<ref name="RoT" />}}
Tho'natu was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final days of the [[New Sith Wars]]. As a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], he joined the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] and fought in the [[Ruusan campaign]], the final campaign of the war. Before the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], however, Tho'natu was assigned to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]]'s [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], the ''[[Fairwind]]'', and thus survived the catastrophic detonation of a [[thought bomb]],<ref name="RoT" /> a deadly [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] used in a failed attempt to destroy the Army of Light.<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

By [[990 BBY]], ten years after the war,<ref name="masterdate">{{CSWECite|III|238|Tho'natu, Master}} notes Tho'natu was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was promoted during the peacetime following the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]] and, as a Master, led a [[Confrontation on Ambria|mission]] ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the same battle, which ended in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] according to {{CSWECite|I|xiii|A Timeline of Galactic Events}}</ref> Tho'natu had been granted the rank of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master. In that year, a [[message drone]] was sent to the Jedi, alerting them to the presence of a helpless, grievously injured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] under the care of the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]] [[Caleb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. Realizing that this must refer to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] after whom [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] Farfalla and four other Jedi had recently hunted on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;a [[Duel on Tython|mission]] from which they did not return&mdash;the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] assembled a [[Ambria strike team|team]] led by Tho'natu, consisting of five other Jedi Masters and eight Jedi Knights. Aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|Jedi cruiser]] ''[[Light of Truth]]'', Thon'atu led the team to Ambria to arrest the Sith Lord. Upon arriving, Tho'natu and his team of Jedi found the brutally mutilated remains of Caleb's corpse outside the healer's hut. As the Jedi approached the abode, Tho'natu announced their presence, claiming that they had arrived to help. They were abruptly [[Confrontation on Ambria|attacked]] by the maniacal former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darovit]], and Tho'natu and the other Jedi quickly struck him down.<ref name="RoT" />

[[File:BaneZannah-DoE.png|thumb|right|250px|Darths Bane and Zannah eluded Tho'natu, ensuring the survival of their Sith Order]]
Tho'natu then entered Caleb's hut, where he found five [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]], which he assumed were taken as trophies from the five Jedi who had been killed on Tython. Observing that Darovit had a missing hand and that he was in possession of a golden [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] identical to Farfalla's, Tho'natu assumed incorrectly that Darovit was the Sith Lord whom Farfalla and the others had hunted. He surmised that Darovit had killed them, but had been grievously injured and had gone to Caleb for help after driving himself insane by attempting to heal himself with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Tho'natu then assumed that Caleb had sent the message to the Jedi, but that Darovit had found out and killed the healer in retaliation. Mistakenly believing the Sith to finally be obliterated from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Tho'natu and the other Jedi returned to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], taking with them the stolen lightsabers, so that they could be kept in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], as well as Caleb's remains, so that he could be given a proper [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]].<ref name="RoT" /> A monument was later created in the Jedi Temple on which the names of Caleb and the Jedi killed on Tython were commemorated.<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

However, unbeknownst to Tho'natu, Darovit's cousin&mdash;the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]&mdash;had killed Caleb and [[Summon fear|driven]] Darovit insane so that he would attack the Jedi when they arrived. She had then [[Force stealth|concealed the presences]] of herself and her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]&mdash;the true Sith Lord to whom the message actually referred&mdash;and hidden in a small trapdoor inside Caleb's hut. As Tho'natu reported the final destruction of the Sith to the Jedi Council upon his return to Coruscant, Zannah's plan to keep the survival of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] a secret was completed.<ref name="RoT" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Be ready for anything.|Tho'natu, to his team of Jedi|<ref name="RoT" />}}
Due to his [[Time/Legends|time]] spent on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] in the New Sith Wars, Tho'natu was well aware of the danger that a Sith Lord presented. As such, he was initially cautious during the mission to Ambria. He and his team of Jedi were fooled by Zannah's ploy to keep the Sith a secret, as Tho'natu surmised incorrectly that the Sith had been eliminated.<ref name="RoT" />

==Powers and abilities==
Tho'natu was a Force-sensitive and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of the Jedi during the final years of the New Sith Wars, achieving the rank of Master by 990 BBY. Tho'natu was proficient in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], and when he was sent to deal with the last known Sith Lord on the planet Ambria, he and his team of Jedi killed Darovit with ease.<ref name="RoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tho'natu was created by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for his [[2006]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', the second installment in the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].
